ev.q: Set in the world of Thedas, players assume the role of Hawke, a human mage
players are accompanied by different companions, who can be recruited into Hawke's party
Critics praised the companions featured in the game
players will make many decisions that lead to different consequences
praised the game's combat noting it was faster than its predecessor
Outside combat, players engage in dialogue, asking or answering questions
A skill tree is present for players to unlock talents in a non-linear manner
Hawke's sex and appearance can be customized
players encounter different containers and loot
